st: The real Western luxury? Not the Rolex: sun/air/water (biological nature).

sec.p: When electricity and services stop being invisible, you realise that wealth is the ecosystem: clean air, visible sun, usable water. Not the city's “hipster” nature: a chemical, elemental nature, beneath the Self.

Monkeys like organised gangs guarding the ice creams and attacking children: an evolutionary reminder. Varanasi: animals amid smoke and pyres, food amid remains and city. Biological dystopia, not cyberpunk.

sec.t: ff.143.3 Sun and the Asian Brown Cloud
sec.p: A permanent grey haze: it isn't just air that's missing, it's the sun. The irony of geoengineering: under the ABC (Asian Brown Cloud) the sky is already “filtered”.

Survival: bonfires of plastic and rubbish to keep warm. Subsistence: the “land of fire” (Azerbaijan) and the Flame Towers. Transcendence: funeral pyres in Varanasi. When fire = plastic and air = a grey wall, the biological assumptions collapse.

rel: ff.51 The religion of the 21st century?
